data.long_description:
Welcome to your new home in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle — a beautifully designed 4-bedroom + Maid's villa in the highly sought-after Heilbronn Villas community. Spanning 1873.89 sqft, this spacious unfurnished villa offers the perfect mix of comfort, style, and modern living.

Step inside to discover 5 elegant bathrooms and well-planned living spaces, featuring built-in wardrobes, an open kitchen equipped with high-quality appliances, and a dedicated study room ideal for work or quiet downtime. With maid and laundry rooms included, everyday family life becomes even more convenient.

Enjoy peaceful mornings on your private balcony or unwind in the lush private garden while taking in the serene community surroundings. This pet-friendly home welcomes your furry companions. Additional conveniences include a pantry, storage room, covered parking, and central air conditioning for year-round comfort.

Developed by Heilbronn Properties, this brand-new villa is crafted with privacy and long-term value in mind. The community is fully serviced with essential utilities such as electricity, water, and fibre-optic connectivity, ensuring a smooth living experience.

Presented by Provident Real Estate, one of Dubai’s leading and most trusted property agencies, this villa is ready to become your next home.

Rent this exceptional villa for AED 190,000 and begin creating lasting memories in Jumeirah Village Circle. Contact us today to arrange a viewing and experience the comfort and charm of this remarkable property.

Company Name: Provident Real Estate
RERA ORN: 1933
